```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const dayKey = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  fetch('assets/metrics.json?d=' + dayKey)
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(d => {
      if (!d) return;
      const hEl = document.getElementById('kpi-h-index');
      const iEl = document.getElementById('kpi-i10');
      const cEl = document.getElementById('kpi-citations');
      const uEl = document.getElementById('kpi-updated');
      if (hEl && d.h_index) hEl.textContent = d.h_index;
      if (iEl && d.i10_index) iEl.textContent = '(i10: ' + d.i10_index + ')';
      if (cEl && d.citations_all) {
        cEl.textContent = Number(d.citations_all).toLocaleString('en-US');
      }
      // Date of the last successful Google Scholar fetch (not of the last run).
      const gsDate = d.scholar_updated_date || d.updated_date;
      if (uEl && gsDate) {
        uEl.textContent = '(' + gsDate + ')';
      }
      // Scopus boxes stay hidden until the updater has real Scopus numbers.
      if (d.scopus_h_index && d.scopus_citations) {
        document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-h').textContent = d.scopus_h_index;
        document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-c').textContent = Number(d.scopus_citations).toLocaleString('en-US');
        const sParts = [];
        if (d.scopus_i10_index != null) sParts.push('i10: ' + d.scopus_i10_index);
        if (d.scopus_documents) sParts.push(d.scopus_documents + ' docs');
        if (sParts.length) document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-docs').textContent = '(' + sParts.join(' · ') + ')';
        if (d.scopus_updated_date) document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-updated').textContent = '(' + d.scopus_updated_date + ')';
        document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-h-box').hidden = false;
        document.getElementById('kpi-scopus-c-box').hidden = false;
        document.getElementById('kpi-prize-box').hidden = true;  // the prize is still in the bio above
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
```
